programme.title: K1
programme.sub-title: S01 : E46 K1 World Grand Prix: Final 14, Osaka, 2003
programme.desc: K-1 World Grand Prix 2003 Final Elimination was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. The event was held at the Osaka Dome in Osaka, Japan on Saturday, October 11, 2003 in front of 31,700 spectators. It was the final elimination competition for the K-1 World Grand Prix 2003, involving fourteen fighters from across the world, with all bouts being fought under K-1 Rules (100 kg/156-220 lbs). The fourteen fighters were a mixture of invitees or had qualified via previous events.

programme.title: K1
programme.sub-title: S01 : E47 K1 World Grand Prix: Finals, Tokyo, 2003
programme.desc: K-1 World Grand Prix 2003 Final was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. The event was held at the Tokyo Dome in Tokyo, Japan on Saturday, December 6, 2003 in front of 67,320 spectators. It was the eleventh K-1 World Grand Prix final involving ten of the world's best fighters (two being reservists). The eight finalists had almost all qualified via preliminary events, while two additional fighters were invited as reserve fighters (for more detail on this see bulleted list below), with all bouts being fought under K-1 Rules (100 kg/156-220 lbs).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 98 features the highly anticipated return of Jamal Ben Saddik (36-9, 29 KO) against the Estonian powerhouse Uku Jürjendal (20-9, 16 KO). In the co-main event of the evening, GLORY Welterweight World Champion Chico Kwasi (43-5-1, 23 KO) is set to defend his title against number two ranked welterweight Teodor Hristov (18-3, 7 KO). Meanwhile, two of 2024’s best prospects will clash as Cem Caceres (18-1, 14 KO) faces Mory Kromah (31-2-1, 18 KO).

programme.title: Treasure of Silver Lake
programme.desc: Een postkoets wordt overvallen door de bende van kolonel Brinkley, die een schatkaart zoekt. Fred Engel wil de moord op zijn vader wreken en schakelt Old Shatterhand en Winnetou in. Samen gaan ze op zoek naar de tweede helft van de kaart, terwijl de bende hen op de hielen zit.

programme.title: The Red Pony

programme.title: Thunder at the Border
programme.desc: Winnetou en zijn zus Nscho-chi vluchten voor de bende van de Silers en vinden hulp bij pelsjagers onder leiding van Old Firehand. In Miramonte dreigt een aanval om een gevangengenomen bendelid te bevrijden. Terwijl Winnetou en Old Firehand helpen de stad te verdedigen, komt ook een verrassend familiegeheim aan het licht.

programme.title: $100,000 for Ringo
programme.desc: Lee Barton komt aan in Rainbow Valley, waar men hem verwart met Ward Cluster, een man die stierf in de burgeroorlog. Bartons leven raakt verstrengeld met lokale conflicten, een moordzuchtige baas en een zoekgeraakte schat. Samen met een sheriff zoekt hij gerechtigheid en een toekomst met Ward’s zoon Sean.

programme.title: Shoot the Living and Pray for the Dead
programme.desc: Nadat Dan Hogan en zijn bende een bank hebben overvallen, huren ze een mysterieuze man in om hen over de Mexicaanse grens te leiden in ruil voor de helft van de buit.

programme.title: Apache Fury
programme.desc: Een rechter herkent tijdens een Apache-aanval een man die hij ooit onrecht aandeed. Samen met zijn verloofde en andere postkoetsreizigers zoekt hij toevlucht in een afgelegen rustplaats. Daar, omsingeld door dreiging van buiten én spanningen van binnen, wordt hij geconfronteerd met schuld, gevaar en onvermijdelijke keuzes.

programme.title: The Ruthless Four
programme.desc: In Nevada vinden goudzoeker Sam Cooper en zijn partner goud. Maar Sam's hebzuchtige partner begint te schieten op Sam die zijn toevlucht zoekt in de goudmijn.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: In 1876, Capt. Phillip Donlin hoort dat zijn vrouw, Celie, een affaire heeft met luitenant Haywood. Gebroken door de verraad vertrekt hij op een missie om generaal Custer te waarschuwen voor een grote Sioux-aanval bij Little Big Horn. Spanningen ontstaan tussen de troepen als Donlin zijn orders negeert om een heldhaftige waarschuwing te geven.

programme.title: Twice a Judas
programme.desc: Luke Barrett ontwaakt in de woestijn met geheugenverlies en een geweer met 'Dingus'. In de saloon ontmoet hij een mysterieuze vreemdeling die zijn naam kent. Langzaam ontdekt Luke dat hij met zijn partner is ingehuurd om zijn broer Victor te doden. Terwijl herinneringen terugkomen, wachten hem grote keuzes.

programme.title: Gunman of Ave Maria
programme.desc: Mann is een schutter die van een jeugdvriend te horen krijgt dat zijn vader jaren eerder is vermoord door zijn moeder en haar minnaar.

programme.title: My Name Is Shanghai Joe
programme.desc: Een Chinese immigrant, net aangekomen in Amerika, vecht om Mexicaanse slaven te bevrijden van hun wrede meester.

programme.title: Dig Your Grave Friend... Sabata's Coming
programme.desc: Na de Burgeroorlog keert Steve McGowan terug om wraak te nemen op Miller, de tirannieke tycoon die zijn vader liet vermoorden. In de gevangenis bundelt hij onverwacht de krachten met bandiet Pompero. Hun strijd wordt bemoeilijkt door Millers verloofde Helen, die hen gevangen neemt maar later besluit hen te helpen tegen haar corrupte toekomstige echtgenoot.

programme.title: Bonanza Compilation Episodes 28, 29, 30
programme.desc: De Wild West-avonturen van Ben Cartwright en zijn zoons terwijl ze hun ranch in Nevada runnen en verdedigen terwijl ze de omringende gemeenschap helpen.

programme.title: Hellgate
programme.desc: Onterecht beschuldigd van spionage belandt een man in de beruchte Hellgate-gevangenis. Na een mislukte ontsnapping wacht hem eenzame opsluiting. Maar wanneer een dodelijke plaag uitbreekt, krijgt hij een onverwachte kans op verlossing. Zal hij overleven en zijn naam zuiveren?

programme.title: Dead are Countless
programme.desc: Als kind zag Johnny hoe soldaten zijn vader doodden. Getekend door wrok groeit hij uit tot een meedogenloze outlaw die elke soldaat neerhaalt die hij tegenkomt. Het leger stuurt luitenant Garringo eropuit om Johnny levend te arresteren, maar de jacht verandert al snel in een gevaarlijk spel van wraak en recht.

programme.title: Guns Of The Revolution
programme.desc: In Mexico leidt een krankzinnige generaal zijn eigen oorlog tegen de kerk.

programme.title: Pancho Villa
programme.desc: Een verraad in een wapendeal zet de Mexicaanse revolutionair Pancho Villa ertoe aan een wapenopslagplaats van het Amerikaanse leger in Columbus, New Mexico, te overvallen.

programme.title: Challenge of the Frontier
programme.desc: Beasley, die achter Gayner's land aanzit, wil zijn dochter ontvoeren. Maar Dale hoort hun plan en ontvoert haar zelf. Wanneer Gayner aankomt om zijn dochter terug te halen, vermoordt Beasley hem en laat de sheriff Dale arresteren voor de moord.

programme.title: Cry Blood Apache
programme.desc: Bende sadistische cowboys laten niets in hun weg staan in hun zoektocht naar goud.

programme.title: Against a Crooked Sky
programme.desc: Een eenzame schutter spoort de leden van een vogelvrije bende op die zijn vrienden hebben vermoord.

programme.title: A Coffin for the Sheriff
programme.desc: Anthony Steffen speelt Shenandoah, een mysterieuze man die na een gevaarlijke inwijding aansluit bij een meedogenloze bende wegpiraat. Wanneer de groep hem verdenkt van verraad, ontdekken ze zijn ware motief: wraak. Een spannend verhaal over vertrouwen, geheimen en vergelding in het wilde westen.

programme.title: Hannie Caulder
programme.desc: Een plattelandsvrouw huurt een premiejager in om haar te leren omgaan met een pistool, zodat ze wraak kan nemen.

programme.title: Alien Thunder
programme.desc: Dit is het tragische verhaal van de voortvluchtige Almighty Voice (Gordon Tootoosis) uit Saskatchewan, een Cree-indiaan die uit wanhopige honger wordt gearresteerd voor het stelen van overheidsvee.

programme.title: Convict Stage
programme.desc: Ben zit achter de gebroeders Sims aan sinds ze zijn zus hebben neergeschoten. Zijn vrouw, die dreigt hem te verlaten, ziet zijn kans om haar terug te krijgen en zijn wraak te krijgen wanneer de broers gevangen worden genomen en op de postkoets naar de gevangenis worden vervoerd.

programme.title: No Killing Without Dollars
programme.desc: Lawrence White keert terug naar Owell Rock om de moord op zijn vader te wreken. Om zijn plannen te kunnen uitvoeren, verandert hij zijn naam en laat hij een andere man zich voordoen als "Lawrence White."

programme.title: The Tall Texan
programme.desc: Een groep reizigers reist door Comanche County op zoek naar goud op Indiase begraafplaatsen. De groep bestaat uit een cowboy en zijn vrouw, een sheriff met een moordenaar in bewaring, en een zeekapitein met een duister verleden. Nadat een renegaat hen vertelt over een goudveld, wordt hebzucht hun belangrijkste drijfveer.

programme.title: Deadly Trackers
programme.desc: Jeff wil elk van de vijf bandieten vermoorden die zijn arme zus hebben beroofd, verkracht en vermoord.

programme.title: Massacre
programme.desc: Een bende wapensmokkelaars wordt gezocht door zowel de Mexicaanse Rurales als de Yaqui-indianen. De Rurales willen voorkomen dat de indianen onschuldige boeren aanvallen, terwijl de indianen wraak willen nemen voor de valse medicijnen die hun kinderen blind maakten. De bende wordt gevangen, maar beiden worden omsingeld door de woedende indianen in een verlaten missie. Kunnen politie en criminelen samenwerken om te overleven?

programme.title: Degueyo
programme.desc: Ramons bende valt Danger City aan op zoek naar een schat. Ze doden of gijzelen de mannen en dreigen vrouwen en kinderen met de meedogenloze “Deguello”. Vier mannen, zelf op jacht naar Ramon, besluiten de stad te helpen in haar wanhopige verdediging.

programme.title: Halleluja and Sartana Strike Again
programme.desc: Twee oplichters, waaronder een die zich voordoet als missionaris, proberen een kerkelijke groep te bedriegen. Maar in deze slapstick western raken ze verstrikt in de chaos van een gekke bende grondrovers. Humor, verwarring en avontuur volgen!

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: Een speciale agent uit Chicago wordt naar het westen gestuurd om de beruchte gebroeders Reno op te pakken.

programme.title: Santa Fe Trail
programme.desc: In 1854 worden Jeb Stuart, George Custer en andere afgestudeerden van West Point naar Kansas gestuurd om daar te helpen pacificeren voordat de aanleg van de spoorlijn naar Santa Fe kan worden hervat.

programme.title: White Fang
programme.desc: De wolfhond White Fang helpt een verslaggever, een pelsjager, een non, een jonge Eskimo-jongen en zijn vader om een goudmijnstadje te ontdoen van een slonzige misdaadbaron in het Canadese Yukon van 1896.

programme.title: Comin' at Ya!
programme.desc: De broers Pike en Polk vallen een bruiloft aan, schieten de bruidegom neer en ontvoeren vrouwen om ze te verkopen. H. H. Hart overleeft en jaagt de broers op. Hij bevrijdt de vrouwen, maar wordt gevangen genomen, enkel overlevend dankzij zijn gevangene Polk.

programme.title: Django Kill... If You Live, Shoot!
programme.desc: Verschillende facties vechten om gestolen goud in een surrealistische stad.

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: Na het beroven van een Mexicaanse bank, neemt pa Longworth de buit en laat zijn partner Rio achter om gevangen genomen te worden, maar Rio ontsnapt en gaat op zoek naar pa in Californië.

programme.title: Colt in the Hand of the Devil
programme.desc: Bendeleider El Condor valt zoveel goudkaravanen aan dat de woestijn bij Las Vegas ‘Valley of Death’ wordt genoemd. Het leger zet een hoge beloning uit en lokt de gevangene Pat Scotty uit de cel om El Condor te stoppen.

programme.title: The Man from Utah
programme.desc: In een paardrijdwedstrijd willen de slechteriken dat John Weston verliest. Wanneer hij niet meegaat voegen ze een verzekering toe: een vergiftigde naald onder zijn zadel.

programme.title: The Counterfeit Kid
programme.desc: Jack, een eenvoudige boerenknecht, moet hulp krijgen van een groep wilde buitenbeentjes en een schat vinden voordat de bandiet die hij imiteert hem vindt.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Who said dessert couldn't come before dinner? In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui serves up a hedonistically hard-to-beat Carrot Cake, made extra-moist with applesauce and tons of cream cheese icing. Micah Trainor ditches dessert and heads for the healthy option - a Cider Poached Chicken Waldorf Salad full of pecans and cinnamon for that classic cake flavour. Poppy Sandler innovates with Indian inspiration - carrot cake becomes Carrot Rostis, thin pancakes dished out with perfectly poached eggs and a homemade savoury raisin jam. Tiera Singh returns to the Rock and makes Jerk Crab Salad Mango Rolls. Jazzing up the crab meat with a blend of Jamaican jerk and autumn spices, she finishes the dish by wrapping the mixture in layers of smooth avocado slices and juicy mango.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Charming host Vijaya Selvaraju demystifies a number of Indian dishes like Dal Soup in a crockpot and Fish in (three-ingredient) Red Chili Chutney.

programme.title: Global Street Eats
programme.desc: Chef Dev shares recipes for international street food dishes that take inspiration from other countries, including a Mexican-inspired British Burrito, American-inspired Korean Fried Chicken, and Indian-inspired Guyanese Duck Curry.

programme.title: Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: Super Tonics by Meredith Youngson! Follow along as Shahir prepares healthy, delicious beverages and foods including brownie batter chia pudding, a blue lavender latte, chai cinnamon roll baked oatmeal, and much more!

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: The key ingredient in this episode of One World Kitchen is mangoes! Host Vijaya Selvaraju uses mangoes for some classic Indian dishes.

programme.title: Global Veggies
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 USA, Vietnam, Spain, India
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by the USA - Scalloped Cassava Casserole, Vietnam - Pear Summer Rolls, Spain - Hempseed Romesco with Leeks, and India - Potato Biryani Hash!

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Cheerful host Vijaya Selvaraju shows us just how easy Indian dishes can be incorporated into everyday meals.

programme.title: Global Street Eats
programme.desc: Chef Dev shares straightforward recipes for street foods that have gained popularity around the world. including Dan Dan Noodles from China. Doner Kebab from Turkey. and Samosas from India.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Go-to Indian menu item Lamb Rogan Josh is one thing, but Lamb Sweetbreads Rogan Josh with Aloo Gobi Foam? That's a CombiNATION Plates thing! Craig Wong is at it again in this USA + India episode. After India, Chef moves on to the USA to answer the question, 'is everything better battered and fried?' with his Country Fried Torchon of Foie Gras. The common ingredient for these two distant nations is lobster, and really, who doesn't love it? For the US, it's Lobster with Cajun Spice Grits and Pickled Okra, and for India, check out Lobster Curry with Coconut Milk. The finale features Catfish like you've never seen it. Cooked Tandoori style and served with Collard Greens Paneer and Peach Bhaji, it's a one-of-a-kind CombiNATION sensation!

programme.title: Global Veggies
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 India, Belgium, Italy, China
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by India - Bhindi Masala-Style Nopales, Belgium - Belgian Plantain Waffles, Italy - Almond Crusted Portobellos, and China - Sichuan Artichoke Stir Fry!

programme.title: Spencer's Big 30
programme.desc: Indian meals are the epitome of a full family dinner. Host Spencer Watts uses bold flavours to make classic Butter Chicken and refreshing Mango Lassi.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Robert Jewell explores recipes using two very different ingredients that start with the letter "O," oats and okra. For his first dish, Robert uses okra in a classic cornmeal cake recipe, but bumps up the flavour factor with spicy jalapenos. Robert balances the heat of the jalapeno with a tart green tomato and crunchy red onion salsa. In his next recipe, Robert keeps the heat, but switches up his recipes for a curry-spiced oat pancake. This Indian inspired dish needs something to cool it down and Robert knows exactly what that is - sweet, silky applesauce! He's up for the challenge when it comes to combining okra and oats into one dish, and the results are tasty!

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe; Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Ever crave a delicious Indian feast? Host Vijaya Selvaraju cooks up Indian classics for a delightful family meal.

programme.title: Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: Craving Vegan by Sam Turnbull! Follow along as Shahir prepares vegan white lasagna, jackfruit pulled pork, tofu tikka masala, and much more!

programme.title: Spencer's Big 30
programme.desc: It's Tandoori Take-Out night as host Spencer Watts prepares five quick and easy Indian dishes that take little time, but are big in flavour.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Take a trip around the world in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Missy Hui hits the Great Wall running - her Chinese Fried Rice recipe is a classic complete with crispy bacon, crunchy onions and savoury scallions. Then, Poppy Sandler sets off for the Land of the Rising Sun with Crispy Sushi Rice and Spicy Tuna; sriracha mayo seasons the sushi-grade tuna and sticky short-grain rice cakes are fried (fried rice anyone?) to a beautiful golden-brown. Micah Trainor's Gorgonzola-Chive Arancini puts a Sicilian spin on frying rice - panko-crusted arborio is creamy and flavourful with blue cheese and chives for this ultra-indulgent Italian redux. Rice Papad with Turkey Tikka Masala is Tiera Singh's Indian extravaganza, taken to the top with puffy (fried, of course!) rice papad and tender braised turkey legs drenched in old school tomato-spice curry.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 DIY your Indian Food
programme.desc: Cheerful host Vijaya Selvaraju shows us how to DIY some of the important staples of Indian cuisine.

programme.title: Global Street Eats
programme.desc: Chef Dev prepares some of his favorite South Asian street foods, including Nihari Stew from Pakistan, Momo Dumplings from Nepal, and sweet Jalebi from India.

programme.title: Global Veggies
programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 Portugal, Argentina, India, Japan
programme.desc: Chef Pino Di Cerbo creates veggie dishes inspired by Portugal, Argentina, India, and Japan!

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Host Vijaya Selvaraju makes delectable Indian dishes using versatile Indian spices and flavours.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Host Joanna Chery elevates four Greek dishes using wine and spirits in this episode of One World Kitchen. First up, brown rice Stuffed Mussels infused with Greek dry white wine, tangy lemon juice, and fragrant spices - perfect for a sunny day by the sea. When evening rolls around, Joanna insists that red wine is a must! She makes a Sausage and Pepper Stew packed with golden-brown sausages and colourful bell peppers simmered in yummy tomatoes and a healthy dose of red wine. Then, she pulls out some brandy for a tender and delicious Beef Orzo Casserole. Finally, Joanna uses a traditional licorice-flavoured spirit called ouzo to bake a mouth-watering batch of Drunk Cookies.

programme.title: The Urban Vegetarian
programme.desc: Desiree Nielsen shows how salads can be a tasty main AND served warm with a grilled romaine salad.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S03 : E27 Cheese with Every Meal!
programme.desc: Cheese - a staple in traditional Greek cuisine! Talented home cook Joanna Chery fries up two delicious ap- petizers called Saganaki, both featuring two different types of cheese. First, she fries up kefaltyri, a hard, salty cheese in a dramatic burning flame of ouzo (licorice-flavoured alcohol) - Opa! Then, Joanna shows us a popular Fried Shrimp and Cheese appetizer using tasty feta and tender shrimp. Pair both dishes with a Greek rustic bread and you've nailed it! Next up, Joanna prepares a Greek classic - Spanakopita. This mouth-watering dish is made up of creamy ricotta, crispy phyllo pastry, fresh spinach, and a hint of dill (yum!). Moving on, Joanna showcases her all-time favourite Greek meal - Pastisio. For dessert, cheesy sweet tarts called Melitinia Cookies. Commonly served at parties, these ooey-gooey mascarpone-filled creations are to die for!

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Home cook Joanna Chery prepares a series of traditional Greek dishes including Stuffed Vine Leaves - a classic dish made of lemon-doused grape leaves and stuffed with fluffy rice, fragrant herbs, and juicy beef. Then, she prepares a healthy and hearty dish called Giant Baked Beans. Typically used as a side, it pairs well with Jo- anna's next dish - succulent roast lamb and lemony potatoes. Finally, Joanna makes a Greek specialty - Fried Dough Ribbons. Satisfy your sweet tooth with these fried, coiled dough ribbons drizzled with sweet honey and sprinkled with sugar. Simple, fun, and evERS-popular in Greek cuisine, this dish is great for sharing amongst family and friends.

programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: The video captures a diverse range of musical performances, each with its own unique style and energy. Jesse Teasdale and Jade share their experiences running Golden Fries at Bluesfest Ottawa, highlighting the busy and memorable nights they have encountered. They discuss their popular menu items, including the classic poutine and crispy chicken poutine, and how they cater to large orders from artists and their crews. The video also features snippets of heartfelt and passionate lyrics from various songs, showcasing themes of love, longing, and personal reflection. Viewers will experience the dynamic atmosphere of Bluesfest Ottawa, the dedication of the Golden Fries team, and the emotional depth conveyed through the musical performances. This content offers a blend of culinary entrepreneurship, festival culture, and musical artistry.

Chris discovers a clever way to holiday for free in the Australian Tropics!

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S1 - "Japan and New Zealand"

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S1 - "South Pacific Paradise"

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Kenya's Great Grasslands"

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Cultural Indonesia"

programme.title: Best Fails of the Month
programme.sub-title: S06 : E06 Best Fails of the Month | Ep. 6.6
programme.desc: The best of the worst for May '23.

programme.title: High Lonesome
programme.desc: A young drifter is suspected of murder in this stirring production from writer/director Alan Le May (best known for writing The Searchers). John Drew Barrymore stars as Cooncat, a troubled young man who has to steal to survive. With no friends in West Texas, he falls in with some bad customers who involve him in some terrible crimes. The strong cast includes Chill Wills, Jack Elam, and John Archer, with cinematography by Oscar winner W. Howard Greene.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: Randolph Scott plays James Barlow, an agent from Chicago hired to bring the notorious Reno brothers to justice. But wouldnt you know it? The Reno gang includes a beautiful young woman (Mala Powers), who catches Barlows eye. This western from director Tim Whelan (The Thief of Bagdad) features cinematography by two-time Oscar winner Ray Rennahan (Gone With The Wind), while the screenplay was by noted author Horace McCoy (They Shoot Horses, Dont They?). Theres also an all-star cast, including Forrest Tucker, J. Carrol Naish, Edgar Buchanan, Denver Pyle, and several other shaggy sidewinders!

programme.title: Raiders of Old California
programme.desc: The end of the Mexican-American War finds a brazen U.S. Calvary captain and his men taking over a Spanish land grant. Albert C. Gannaway (The Badge of Marshall Brennan) directs an all-star cast including Jim Davis (Jock Ewing of Dallas), Arleen Whelan (Young Mr. Lincoln) and Lee Van Cleef (The Good, The Bad, and the Ugly). Also, look for appearances by legendary country & western stars Marty Robbins and Faron Young.

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead
programme.desc: When a rustler named Faro kills one of his own henchmen and blames it on Sheila O'Conner, Red and Little Beaver set out to clear Sheila and to find evidence against Faro and his gang.

programme.title: Rawhide Rangers
programme.desc: Blackie's gang is creating havoc and the Ranger, Brand Calhoun and his brother go to investigate.

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cyclone Tom Saunders starts a ruckus in a Chinese laundry and has to go before a judge. Unable to pay his fine, he is bailed out by a local cattle rancher and agrees to do 30 days' work for him. It's not too long before he becomes enmeshed in a war between rustlers and outlaws.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Ranch
programme.desc: Flagg is relocating flood victims to Gunsmoke Ranch. The Three Mesquiteers know Flagg to be a crook and try to warn them. They ignore the warning and improve the land only to find that it has been condemned for a new dam.

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: Roy Rogers finds himself elected sheriff in a wild Texas town after the Civil War. But can Roy handle a place under martial law? And can he save Gabby Hayes from being executed? And how many songs will he get to sing? Clear the burrs from your saddle and get ready for a good one, also starring Marjorie Reynolds, plus Sally Payne as Belle Starr, Queen of the Oklahoma Outlaws!

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: What happens when Abraham Lincoln himself comes to New Mexico to discuss a treaty with Native American chief Acoma (Ted de Corsia)? Can the hotbed of emotions be quieted by cavalry Captain Hunt (Lew Ayres)? Or will the Captains superiors insist on provoking with the native tribe? Find out what happens in this fictional tale packed with action from 1951!

programme.title: Song of Arizona
programme.desc: This Roy Rogers adventure finds Gabby Whitaker (Gabby Hayes) running a ranch for wayward boys. One of the boys uses stolen money to help Gabby pay off his debts, but things unravel when the boys father, a notorious outlaw named King Blaine, is murdered; the rest of the Blaine gang show up at Gabbys looking for the loot! Director Frank McDonald works with a fine cast, including Dale Evans, Lyle Talbot, and of course, Roys beloved horse Trigger.

programme.title: Hands Across The Border
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures western about horse breeders vying for a contract with the U.S. Army. The cast also includes such favorites as Onslow Stevens and Guinn Big Boy Williams, while songs include Hey Hey (It's a Great Day), Dreaming to Music, and The Girl with the High Button Shoes. For movie buffs: The music for the title song, Hands Across the Border, was composed by none other than Hoagy Carmichael!

programme.title: Public Cowboy No. 1
programme.desc: Gene Autry and Smiley Burnette are back, and this time theyre dealing with some very modern thinking rustlers. These new criminals have taken up the latest technologies to outsmart the authorities, including shortwave radios and airplanes! Can Gene and Smiley get em? You bet! Songs include The West Aint What It Used To Be, I Got the HeebieJeebie Blues, and The Defective Detective from Brooklyn. Gene also gets romantic when he sings, I Picked up the Trail when I Found You...

programme.title: Captain Apache (Edited Version)
programme.desc: After Harry T. Collier, a beloved commissioner of Indian Affairs, is murdered in late March during the1880s, Captain Apache, an Indian graduate of West Point, is assigned by the army to investigate the crime. Suspecting that O.J., the sheriff of a town bordering the reservation may be involved in the killing, Apache travels there and finds the sheriff dining with his mistress Maude at the Paradise Saloon. Before Apache can question him, however, O.J. abruptly departs and rides out of town with Apache in pursuit. When Apache apprehends him, O.J. swears that he did not kill Collier and relates that the agents dying words were April Morning. Meanwhile, Griffin, a wealthy landowner and six of his henchmen deliver guns across the border to a corrupt Mexican general who is bent on overtaking the province by force. When Griffin then demands that the general now fulfill his part of the bargain, the general orders him killed, unaware that his lieutenant, Sanchez is in Griffins employ. Rather than killing Griffin, Sanchez shoots the general, and after promoting himself to the post, promises Griffin that he will cross the border in time for April Morning. When O.J. is found murdered, Apache questions Maude, who reveals that O.J. traveled to a Mexican cantina monthly. Apache then rides to the cantina, where he is met by a cavalry patrol led by Sgt. ORourke. Upon learning that the cantina owner has recently been killed, Apache demands that the mans widow, Rosita, take him to Rodriguez, her husbands employer. Rosita then introduces Apache to a Mexican sergeant who allegedly knows where Rodriguez can be found. Unaware that the sergeant is Rodriguez disguised as a soldier, Apache follows him to a church where the priest claims that Rodriguez has claimed sanctuary and is therefore immune to the law.

programme.title: Mohawk
programme.desc: Kurt Neumann (The Fly, Rocketship X-M) directed this bawdy tale of a love that was louder than war drums! With a cast that includes Scott Brady, Rita Gam, and Neville Brand, the story takes place on a remote army post where an artist romances a trio of women, just as a vengeful settler turns the army and the local Iroquois tribe against each other. Film buffs might like to know that the cinematography for this feature is by four-time Oscar nominee Karl Struss, who won an Academy Award in 1929 for his work on Sunrise.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Riders of Destiny
programme.desc: John Wayne sings! Well, not really. His voice was dubbed here, but as Singin Sandy Saunders hes still able to write the code of justice with a blazing sixgun! Hes a government agent out to help a group of ranchers in their battle with a villain who is tying up local water rights. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Al St. John, Yakima Canutt, and Cecilia Parker, Riders of Destiny was filmed early in Waynes career it was his first for Lone Star but the unmistakable swagger is already in place!

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: He Dared Death In The Outlaw's Lair! John Travers (John Wayne) takes on a mysterious gang leader known as The Shadow in this vintage western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Director/writer Robert N. Bradbury (Blue Steel, Riders of Destiny) gets the best of a remarkable cast that includes George Gabby Hayes. Of interest to film buffs is that the feature was shot in various California locations by Oscar winning cinematographer Archie Stout (The Quiet Man).

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: Dad Longworth robs a Mexican bank, takes the loot, and leaves his partner Rio to be captured. However, Rio escapes capture and searches for Dad in California.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: The sons of a Colorado cattle baron, one biological and the other adopted, resent one another and fight for control of their father's cattle empire.

programme.title: Riders of the Deadline
programme.desc: The 50th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy films finds Hoppy in a vengeful mood. When his good friend Tim Mason is unjustly sent to jail and then killed when trying to escape, Hoppys bitterness gets him drummed out of the Texas Rangers. With the help of his pals California Carson and Jimmy Rogers, he sets out to expose the real culprits and clear Tims name. The usual cast is here, including William Boyd as Hoppy, plus Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers, and in one of his earliest roles, Robert Mitchum.

programme.title: The Gunman from Bodie
programme.desc: The Rough Riders, a popular group that thrilled audiences in the early 1940s, are after a gang of rustlers in this B-western from Hollywood's Poverty Row. Starring Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, and Raymond Hatton, this movie features everything from lawmen going undercover to the Rough Riders looking after an orphaned baby! Also, be on the lookout for the beautiful Christine McIntyre, who would go on to appear in several of the Three Stooges shorts for Colombia Pictures.

programme.title: Red Ryder: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
programme.desc: Red Ryder encounters bandits trying to hold up the stagecoach carrying the owner of the Devil's Hole newspaper, Libby Brooks and her brother Gerry. Red successfully drives off the attackers but becomes embroiled in further conflict, leading to a duel that nearly claims his life.

programme.title: Fighting Fury
programme.desc: A THRILLING TALE OF REVENGE AND REDEMPTION! Based on the story Triple Cross for Danger by the widely lauded Western author Walter J. Coburn, Fighting Fury is a thrilling take on the Western revenge drama. Portraying both a father and his son, star of silent and sound cowboy adventure films, Jack Hoxie (Trouble Busters, Law and Lawless) exudes the classic American rustic charm that still defines the genre. The film spins the yarn of Clay Hill Jr. (Hoxie), a Spanish-American boy raised by a Mexican servant who vows bloody vengeance on three malicious ranchers after they murder his parents and turn his life upside down. Featuring fine supporting performances from genre heavies Helen Holmes, Buck Conners and Western mainstay Fred Kohler.

programme.title: With Sitting Bull at the Spirit Lake Massacre
programme.desc: A long-thought-lost film finally surfaces after being unseen for over eight decades. Created and copyrighted by Sunset Productions in 1925 but not released until June 15, 1927, this silent epic features the superior Native American actor Chief Yowlachie (performing here under the name Chief Yowlache) as Sitting Bull. Other fine actors in the cast include the always popular Bryant Washburn and a young Bob Steele, who appears under his real name Bob Bradbury Jr. The story takes place in the 1860s or 1870s near Spirit Lake, Iowa. Settlements of whites are growing in that region but the Sioux Indians also have professed their interest in one such settlement. Chief Sitting Bull surveys the settlement at Spirit Lake from afar and with the advice of the Great Spirit vows to retake the land that belonged to his fathers.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. In General Delivery, the G-men crack a government swindle. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: In Gypsy Traders, a band of gypsies settles down in the Montana Territory to take advantage of the copper stakes they've made in the region. In the nearby town of Bender, a group of shady locals believe the settlers should be stripped of their rights and take the matter to court. When it looks like the judge is going to rule for the gypsies, the outlaws kidnap him and lock him in the local jail.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: In Safe Crackers, Pat and Stoney are ordered to break up a safe cracking gang preying on Colorado banks handling government silver bullion. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. In this episode, the G-Men go to Denver to investigate a silver fraud. Starring Russel Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 Bobbie Jo and the Beatnik
programme.desc: Bobbie Jo falls head over heals for an edgy young poet from New York. He likes her, too, but he's not fond of Hooterville. Of coure, Kate has to show Bobby Jo what this pompous fool is all about. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963. Look for Dennis Hopper as the beatnik.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 My Daughter the Doctor
programme.desc: The family wants Billie Jo to become a doctor, but she wants to go to Hollywood to become an actress. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Jean Yarbrough. And be sure to look for Adam West in a pre-Batman role as Doctor Clayton Harris. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in January, 1964.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Billie Jo recieves an endowment, but instead of using it for medical school, she wishes to go to Hollywood.Kate meets with Judge Drucker to see if she can legally prevent the girl from goinng. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Jean Yarbrough.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E19 Visit from a Big Star
programme.desc: A famous movie star (John Vivyan) stays at the Shady Rest Hotel. He wants to get away from the spotlight for a while, but it appears that Uncle Joe has told the entire valley that the hotel has a special guest. .Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Sam is framed by Duke and his gang, who have kidnapped Linda to prevent Sam from proving his innocence. Its up to Annie and Lofty to save Sam from an angry mob, save Linda from Duke and his gang, and take them down for their crimes. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annies younger brother finds himself in danger when he gets in trouble with The Shadow Gang after running away with a friend. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This entertaining western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 1955.

programme.title: Yellowneck
programme.desc: Location shooting in the Florida Everglades add to this dramatic tale of five Confederate deserters trying to get to Cuba. First, they must overcome snake bites, unfriendly Seminoles, and their own conflicts with each other. How many of the five will actually make it out alive? Lin McCarthy, Stephen Courtleigh, and Berry Kroeger star in this little known example of 1950s independent filmmaking.

programme.title: Custer's Last Stand
programme.desc: The survivor of an Indian attack acquires a rare medicine arrow, and a menacing character named Blade (Reed Howes) will stop at nothing to take it from him. Elmer Clifton (Assassin of Youth, Seven Doors to Death) directs a memorable cast that includes Rex Lease (The Sign of the Wolf, The Monster Walks), Lona Andre (Slaves in Bondage, Death in the Air), and William Farnum (Samson and Delilah). Meanwhile, Frank McGlynn Jr is in the title role of General George A. Custer.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: John Wayne stars as Ted Hayden, a tough hombre who goes undercover to join a gang led by a heartless fiend known only as Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock). Gentry is out to take over a ranch belonging to one of Hayden's friends, but as Hayden finds out, Gentry has a lot more than that up his sleeve. You'll have to watch this two-fisted Western to find out the rest!

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Daughter of the West
programme.desc: A FLAMING PAGE FROM AMERICAN HISTORY Becomes a powerful motion picture...set against the panoramic grandeur of the West!. Martha Vickers stars as Lolita Moreno, a convent raised woman in the 1880s who learns about her Native American heritage through her relationship with an educated Navajo. Morena had been raised at a California mission, but when she leaves to teach school in Arizona, the threads of her mysterious past are revealed. This leads to her involvement with some dangerous people, and a chance to find love in the most unexpected way. The cast includes Phillip Reed, Donald Woods, William Farnum and Milton Kibbee. Pedro de Cordobaa stars as Chief Wykomas.

programme.title: American Empire
programme.desc: This epic of America's westward march stars Leo Carrillo and Preston Foster in a tale of men building a cattle empire, only to battle rustlers, the weather, and each other! The romantic adventure from director William C. McGann (In Old California, Alcatraz Island) features a strong leading performance by Oscar nominated RKO star Richard Dix (Cimarron, The Ghost Ship) plus cinematography by six-time Oscar nominee Russell Harlan (To Kill a Mockingbird, Rio Bravo).

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, killing all but one. The surviving ranger is nursed back to health by Native American Tonto, and takes on the identity of a masked vigilante, determined to bring all outlaws to justice. Culled from episodes of the popular TV series, this feature is great fun for fans of the Lone Ranger. Starring Clayton Moore and Jay Silverheels.

programme.title: Adventures of Gallant Bess
programme.desc: Rather than a gorgeous Hollywood starlet, actor Cameron Mitchell (Carousel), playing cowboy Ted Daniels, shares the screen in this film with a magnificent wild horse named Gallant Bess, who he tames, trains and keeps for himself. But after Ted is gravely injured in a fixed rodeo, Bess is stolen away from him and forced to join a cruel traveling carnival in this fast-paced western from director Lew Landers (The Adventures of Rin Tin Tin).

programme.title: The Two Gun Man
programme.desc: Ken Maynard stars in this vintage western about ranchers under threat from hired gunmen. Director Phil Rosen, whose career dated back to working with Thomas Edison and included several Charlie Chan features, keeps the action hot with help from a strong ensemble, including Charles King, Murdock MacQuarrie, and a horse named Tarzan! Maynard plays Blackie Weed, a marshall going undercover to capture and arrest some cattle rustlers.He finds himself up against some very bad men, and he's soon framed for murder. Watch as Blackie blazes his way to vindication with a .45 in either hand and the flame of righteous anger in his eyes... Kitty: Nita Martin. Joe Kearney: Lafe McKee. Lem Tolliver: Tom London. Ranch Foreman: Walter Perry

programme.title: Fugitive of the Plains
programme.desc: In this continuation of the much loved Billy the Kid serials featuring dreamboat Buster Crabbe (perhaps best known for his numerous appearances as Flash Gordon in the 30s and 40s), Billy finds himself joining an outlaw band led by women in order to, once again, clear his name after being wrongly accused of a crime he did not commit. Helmed by famed B-movie director Sam Newfield, this film also features Al St. John, whose lovable Fuzzy character was as essential to the PRC's Billy the Kid series as Billy himself.

programme.title: Revenge of the Virgins (Edited Version)
programme.desc: The angry and topless female members of a Native American prepare for battle when white treasure hunters move in on their sacred ground. Peter Perry Jr. (The Secret Sex Lives of Romeo and Juliet) directed this early nudie-cutie from a script by legendary cult filmmaker Ed Wood (Plan Nine from Outer Space). Writing under the pen name Peter LaRoche, Wood churned out this screenplay just before he reinvented himself as the author of seedy adult novels.

programme.title: Broadway to Cheyenne
programme.desc: A gang of big-city thugs trying to set up a protection racket out west meet their match in this B-Western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Rex Bell, billed on the old print ads as The heroic idol of young America! stars as Breezy Kildare, a New York detective who happens to be in Wyoming. When Breezy leads a group of cattleman against the well-armed city boys, the bad guys will wish theyd stayed in New York! The rest of the cast includes such favorites from the period as George Gabby Hayes, Roy DArcy, and Marceline Day. (Day worked opposite everyone from John Wayne to Buster Keaton, but retired from acting shortly after this movie at age 25.) Directed by Harry L. Fraser.

programme.title: Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: It's the mounties versus claim jumpers in this drama from Golden Gate Pictures. Based on an action-packed novel by James Oliver Curwood and directed by B. Reeves Maynard (Undersea Kingdom, The Phantom Empire), the film features an outstanding cast of Poverty Row regulars, including Russell Hayden, Inez Cooper, Cliff Nazarro, I. Stanford Jolley, and Kermit Maynard. For movie buffs: Cinematographer Marcel Le Picard began his career in the silent era and finished with exactly 200 credits!

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. Starring Russell Hayden and Jackie Coogan. This episode, Hangfire, also stars Phil Arnold, Dorothy Patrick, and Herman Hack.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. In Hush Money, the G-men are trying to clear a title for a ranch when they discover a murder. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: In Ghost Town Mystery, Pat and Stoney investigate the mysterious closing of a government silver mine and the ghost town left in its wake. They meet several suspicious characters in the empty town, one of whom holds the answers they seek. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney are dispatched to Central City to investigate the disappearance of two Postal Inspectors. They are puzzled by the large amount of mail being sent to the post office in the town of El Dorado. Puzzled, because El Dorado has been a ghost town for years. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, a couple of con men attempt to snare Letty into their scheme and spirit her away to San Francisco. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: In this episode, a Texas Ranger is shot down in cold blood. Determined to bring the killer to justice, the Judge and Jeff turn their focus on Curly, but with a lack of evidence the lawmen are patient until they break the case. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.sub-title: S01 : E22 Luck O' The Irish
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery. In this episode, Judge Roy and Taggart are intrigued by the arrival of Pat O'Hara and his much younger wife Kate. Pat's fondess for drink and gambling has him involved with the town's rowdies who are eying his beautiful bride. The Judge helps sort things out.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, Deputy Jeff Taggart is cheated in a horse deal. When the trader is found murdered, Jeff is the chief suspect. Judge Bean has to discover the actual murderer to save his friend from the gallows. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: In this episode, Judge Bean appoints himself as the legal guardian of a young man whose father was a member of an outlaw gang. Bean's reward -- the boy's uncle puts a $3000 bounty on his head ! Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, the Judge deals with a rigged election. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: A young boy runs away from home because he thinks his father is a coward for not standing up to his abusive boss. Jeff and Roy have to find the boy and convince him that his father is just doing what he has to do in order to provide for his family. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, a woman arrives in town looking for her son. Roy checks around, and finds out that her son is not only in the area, but has become a notorious outlaw. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trailblazer
programme.desc: Daniel Boone (Bruce Bennett) battles Shawnee warriors as he leads a band of settlers into Kentucky in this frontier potboiler from Albert C. Gannaway Productions. Made at the height of Hollywood's fascination with pioneer days, the film also stars Lon Chaney Jr. as Chief Blackfish, and country singer Faron Young as a handsome young suitor for Boone's daughter. There's plenty of action and danger here as the Shawnee are convinced that Boone is trying to steal their land. But Boone is ready, not even fearing death by tomahawk. It isn't how you die, Boone says. It's what you live for.

programme.title: Cry Blood Apache (Edited Version)
programme.desc: An Apache brave seeks vengeance on a band of sadistic gold hunters in this bloody drive-in western. Pitcalin (Jody McRae) leads the marauders who wipe out an Apache camp when they discover gold, only to watch their violent deeds lead to their own demise. Featuring a superb cast that also includes Dan Kemp, Robert Tessier, and Joel McRae, this coldblooded western tale was directed by character actor and filmmaker Jack Starrett (Cleopatra Jones, The Losers).

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling!

programme.title: Winds of the Wasteland
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this Republic Pictures western about the final days of the Pony Express. Former rider John Blair (Wayne) enters a coach race to win a $25,000 government mail contract, but there are dozens of obstacles in his path. The rest of the cast includes Lane Chandler and Phyllis Fraser, plus Lew Kelly (Lady of Burlesque) doing a great comic turn as Rocky OBrien, the eccentric, self-proclaimed mayor of a deserted mining town.

programme.title: In Old Colorado
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy and his crew get involved in a war over water rights in this feature from Harry Sherman Productions and Paramount Pictures. The intrigue starts when crafty Joe Weller (Morris Ankrum) turns two ranchers against each other, which leads to dire results. This is the 33rd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy movies, with WIlliam Boyd in the role he made famous. Also, look for regular Hoppy co-stars Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Andy Clyde as California Carson.

programme.title: Outdoor and Nature
programme.desc: OUTDOOR & Nature, a weekly program that highlights sports, outdoor activities, and the breathtaking scenery of Cyprus, will introduce you to the great outdoors. Each episode highlights government initiatives, community organisations, and volunteer efforts to preserve Cyprus's natural heritage while examining nature, wildlife, and conservation. Take a trip of inspiration, exploration, and adventure with hosts Panicos Pilalis and Aristo Aristeidou. Listen and get motivated to go on your own outdoor adventure in Cyprus!

programme.title: Makarska

programme.title: Malini Angelica Marseille
programme.desc: Malini Angelica travels to Marseille, France’s vibrant Mediterranean port city. She explores its historic Old Port, colorful neighborhoods, and bustling markets, discovering the city’s unique blend of French and North African influences. From sampling local dishes like bouillabaisse to soaking in seaside views and street art, Malini uncovers what makes Marseille one of France’s most dynamic and diverse cities.

programme.title: Whats On - 7 - Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.sub-title: Whats On - 7 - Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

This week, we are bypassing the usual tourist routes to find the heartbeat of the region through its most spectacular festivals. Imagine the sun setting over a lake in Tuscany as the Puccini Festival opens its 72nd season with the powerful melodies of Turandot. From that timeless elegance, we head straight into the high energy of Malta, where the Isle of MTV and the 10th anniversary of the Glitch Festival are turning the islands into a global hub for electronic music. We also explore the stunning heights of the Spanish Pyrenees for the floating stage at Pirineos Sur and hit the iconic cliffs of Santorini for the urban vibes of the Supa Dupa Fly Festival. This is a journey through a region that knows exactly how to celebrate its past while dancing firmly into the future.

programme.desc: Sail along the stunning Adriatic coast of Croatia. From the medieval streets of Dubrovnik to sunlit islands and crystal-clear waters, Croatia reveals a rich tapestry of history, culture, and seaside traditions that make it a Mediterranean gem.

programme.title: Med Destinations Malta
programme.desc: Med Destinations uncovers the magic of Malta, an island rich in history, culture, and stunning coastal landscapes. From medieval streets to turquoise waters, Malta is a Mediterranean treasure.

programme.title: Med Destinations Rimini
programme.desc: Med Destinations visits Rimini, Italy’s seaside gem, where golden beaches meet rich history. From Roman ruins to vibrant nightlife, Rimini offers the perfect mix of culture and coastal charm.

programme.title: Help Save the Med HSTM
programme.desc: Help Save the Med highlights actions to protect the Mediterranean Sea, conserve marine biodiversity and promote environmentally friendly methods, raising awareness of the environmental issues facing the region.

programme.title: Mediterranean Kitchen Spain
programme.desc: Chef Antonio teams up with Chef Kurt in the kitchen to prepare a traditional Spanish comfort food: succulent Iberian pork cheek braised in a luxurious red wine reduction and served with creamy truffle mash. As they cook, the two share kitchen stories, personal memories and the moments that shaped Antonio’s love for food. It’s a simple celebration of what Spanish cooking is all about: good hospitality, tradition and the bonds made over a good meal.

programme.title: HIMASS and Pacijenca Project Montenegro
programme.desc: The Europa Nostra Heritage Awards celebrate exceptional projects and achievements in the conservation and enhancement of Europe’s cultural heritage. The awards celebrate work in fields like conservation, research, education, and heritage awareness throughout Europe.

programme.title: Cinematic Kitchen House
programme.desc: Annette's friend Federico presents a unique property comprising three separate buildings: an independent house currently used as a holiday let, a main house divided into upper and lower apartments, and a traditional stone ruin awaiting full renovation. Each space is rich in rustic Italian charm and character.

programme.title: Brač (Supetar)
programme.desc: On Brač, famed for its white stone, Zlatni Rat beach, and Vidova Gora, we stopped in Supetar to taste tradition. Restaurateur Teo Dragičević served us šporka juha, mišanca, and vitalac—authentic island flavors rooted in Brač’s rich culinary heritage.

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe
programme.desc: Slovenia, a small nation of just two million people, is one of Europe’s most surprising delights. Nestled at the crossroads of the Germanic, Mediterranean, and Slavic worlds, it offers a charm all its own.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Napoli
programme.desc: Malini Angelica visits Naples, in Italy’s vibrant Campania region. She dives into the city’s beautiful chaos to uncover the heart of Neapolitan culture, sampling delicious street food, meeting friendly locals, and exploring its rich history. With its authenticity and energy, Naples stands out as one of Italy’s most captivating cities.

From learning to handle the heat to developing the patience needed to master every detail, discover the dedication behind creating and perfecting a dream design.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Lisbon
programme.desc: Malini Angelica explores Lisbon, the vibrant capital of Portugal. Once founded by the Phoenicians and shaped by Romans, Moors, and explorers of the Golden Age, Lisbon’s layered history is reflected in its culture and charm. During her visit, the city comes alive with the Festas Populares de Lisboa — a June celebration of Saint Anthony filled with music, dancing, and barbecued sardines. Malini samples local favorites like grilled sardines, bifanas, and the famous pastel de nata, and experiences the soulful beauty of Fado music. Lisbon’s warmth, flavor, and festive spirit show why it remains one of Europe’s most beloved cities.

programme.desc: Een bordje ‘hulp gevraagd’ hangt bij de viskar. Naranjina heeft net voor iedereen visjes gehaald als Katharina en Jan aan komen lopen. Ze weet zich nergens anders te verstoppen dan onder tafel. Maar hoe komt ze hier weg? Ze bindt Jans’ veters aan elkaar en sprint ervandoor. Jan springt op, struikelt en belandt met zijn hoofd tegen de borsten van Lilka die net aan komt lopen. De verlekkerde grijns op zijn gezicht veegt Katharina er met een vakkundige tik vanaf.

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Barbecue
programme.desc: Eerlijkheid. Soms doet ze wel eens iets wat misschien ‘stout’ is. Maar ze is wel altijd eerlijk. Ook zonder dat haar ouders op haar letten. En als ze een probleem veroorzaakt zal ze er alles aan doen om dat weer goed te maken.

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Warm!
programme.desc: Het dak van Naranjina’s huis is zo warm geworden dat ze er een eitje op bakt. De anderen zitten onder een boom in de schaduw op een ‘koele’ plek. Freddie zit in een boom/lantaarnpaal op wacht. Ondanks de schaduw heeft Faya het nog steeds te warm, zucht ze… Binnen is het echter nog warmer met de zon die onbarmhartig op het dak schijnt. En het water in de regenton is bijna verdampt. Hitte in de stad…

programme.desc: Ernst en Bobbie moeten het kanon laten knallen voor het speciale bezoek dat de kasteelheer krijgt van de hertog en hertogin. Maar wat nu als het kanon er vandoor gaat?

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen op het Kasteel
programme.sub-title: S06 : E02 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen op het Kasteel: De vaartocht
programme.desc: Ernst en Bobbie denken dat de prachtige boot van de kasteelheer gestolen is door een boef. In een wilde achtervolging weten ze op de boot te komen maar dan is de boef heel iemand anders…

programme.desc: Gargamel doet beroep op zijn grote toverspreukenboek om te kunnen vliegen. Hij is vastberaden om al vliegend een Smurf te vangen voor de tovenaarsbijeenkomst. Enkele mislukte spreuken maken hem tot de grap van de conventie.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa denken terug aan hun avontuur in Australië, waar hun bus pech krijgt in het Achterland.

programme.title: Mouk

programme.desc: Vandaag bezoeken wij de stokstaartjes van DierenPark Amersfoort! Dierverzorger Esther maakt verrijking klaar voor de stokstaartjesgroep. Wat eten stokstaartjes en hoe communiceren deze dieren met elkaar?

programme.desc: Vandaag ga ik naar de rode panda’s van DierenPark Amersfoort! We halen bamboe en maken het verblijf klaar voor een nieuwe dag. Ik kijk mee bij de training van de panda’s door dierverzorger Mirthe om hen voor te bereiden op de grote verhuizing.

programme.desc: De winter komt eraan en alle Smurfen verzamelen hun voorraad eten voor de winter. Opeens komt er een sneeuwstorm aan die de hele voorraad zal vernielen. De Smurfen moeten het dorp verlaten en op zoek gaan naar voedsel. Ze komen aan in een mysterieus kasteel waar er vreemde dingen gebeuren...

programme.desc: Wanneer Luilaksmurf gestoken wordt door een paarse vlieg, breekt er een epidemie uit in het smurfendorp waardoor alle Smurfen paars en dol worden. Grote Smurf zoekt naar een tegengif en ontdekt dat de pollen van een bloem redding kunnen brengen

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.desc: Klungel en Smurfin worden gevangen genomen door de gemene Bombast, die van plan is ze in zijn show tentoon te stellen. Grote Smurf haast zich om hen te redden en met behulp van Gargamel kan hij zijn Smurfen redden.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E29 De Smurfen: Het Vergrootmengseltje
programme.desc: Brilsmurf bereidt een magisch vergrootdrankje dat per ongeluk Potige Smurf zo groot maakt als een mens. Deze grote sterke smurf heeft zijn zinnen er op gezet Gargamel te vangen. Hij brengt hem mee naar Smurfendorp. Grote Smurf zorgt ervoor dat Azrael zijn meester terug jaagt naar zijn kasteel.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E30 De Smurfen: De Slechtweer Smurf
programme.desc: Het is tijd voor de jaarlijkse picknick in het bos, maar het regent! Knutsel heeft een idee en maakt een “weermachine”. Met deze machine kunnen de Smurfen kiezen welk weer het wordt. Maar wat als ze allemaal een ander weertype willen ?

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E31 De Smurfen: Dichtersmurf En Schildersmurf
programme.desc: Omdat ze zich niet gewaardeerd voelen, besluiten Dichtersmurf en Schildersmurf om het dorp te verlaten. Ze gaan op weg naar Stormeiland, zich er niet van bewust zijnde dat Gargamel hen in de val wil lokken. Gelukkig snellen Grote Smurf en zijn trouwe volgelingen hun ter hulp.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E32 De Smurfen: De Onderaardse Smurfen
programme.desc: Er dreigt hongersnood bij de Smurfen. Op hun zoektocht naar eten vinden de uitgehongerde Smurfen een voorraad bevroren voedsel, bewaakt door een bevroren trol, in een mysterieuze grot. De grot herbergt ook een magische diamant. Wanneer de Smurfen de grot ontdooien, probeert Gargamel het voedsel te stelen.

programme.desc: Gedurende één van zijn wandelingen vindt Knustelsmurf een kristallen bol. Deze kristallen bol toont de innerlijke wensen van degene die ernaar kijkt. Deze werd gemaakt door onderaardse trollen die op zoek zijn naar slaven om in hun mijnen te werken.

programme.title: Boes

programme.title: Boes
programme.desc: Het huis van Boes is ijskoud. Het schild van Dolly is helemaal bevroren en zij kan haar kop niet meer bewegen. Boes probeert haar te helpen maar haar schild valt uit elkaar. De kale naakte Dolly krijgt het natuurlijk ijskoud. Als dit maar goed afloopt...

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 Boes: Hé, dat is mijn melk
programme.desc: Een pasgeboren kalf drinkt bij zijn moeder. Ondertussen komt er een mol alle melk stelen. Het kalfje wordt boos en begint aan alle uiers te zuigen. Als Boes de moeder komt melken, wordt het kalf helemaal boos en gaat achter Boes aan.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi en Viola maken kaartenhuisjes, maar bij Stradi wil het niet lukken. Hij wordt boos. Tot groot ongenoegen van Viola wil hij het probleem oplossen met lijm. Hun ruzie loopt zo hoog op, dat het met de allesklevende lijm gevaarlijk wordt.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Het is kermis. Alle bewoners zijn aanwezig, en het is echt gezellig. Trump en Tromb proberen het feest te saboteren. Wat kunnen ze doen met de draaimolen, de fotostand en de toverhoed van Legato?

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: In de ruïnes van het oude kasteel speelt Bass een heldenrol in een film. Hij is fier op het resultaat. Maar door een onvoorzichtigheid van Stradi en Viola wordt de filmband erg beschadigd. De kinderen lossen het wel op hun manier op!

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Trump en Tromb willen op een snelle manier geld verdienen. Ze blazen de brug van het dorp op, en plaatsen een vervangbrug. Daar innen ze tolgeld. De anderen beginnen een nieuwe brug te bouwen. Maar dat laten de twee boeven niet zomaar gebeuren.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Trump en Tromb hebben verschillende voorwerpen gestolen uit het kasteel. Ze verbergen die in een zelfgebouwde boomhut. Stradi en Viola ontdekken de hut op een van hun vele uitstapjes.

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij de boswachter
programme.sub-title: S05 : E05 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij de boswachter: Milieuverontreiniging
programme.desc: Er zijn vaten met gif gevonden in het bos. Ernst en Bobbie bedenken een plan om de boeven die het gif in het bos willen lozen te vangen. En Ernst en Bobbie zouden Ernst en Bobbie niet zijn| als ze daar niet in zouden slagen.

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij de boswachter
programme.sub-title: S05 : E06 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij de boswachter: De schatkaart
programme.desc: Ernst en Bobbie vinden een schatkaart en brengen die naar de boswachter. Even later zijn de boswachter| maar ook de schatkaart verdwenen! Ernst en Bobbie volgen het spoor en zien een boef de schat opgraven…wat een lelijke schurk!

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa denken terug aan hun avontuur in Canada, waar ’n beeldhouwer ’n nieuwe ijshockeystick voor Mouk maakt.
