programme.title: Burden
programme.desc: South Carolina, 1996. Mike Burden is een zwijgzaam man en loyaal lid van de Ku Klux Klan. Maar hij verandert van gedachten wanneer hij verliefd wordt op de alleenstaande moeder Judy...

programme.title: Closed Circuit
programme.desc: Martin en Claudia zijn, behalve dat ze allebei advocaat zijn, ook ex-geliefden. Wanneer ze beiden de verdediging op zich nemen van een internationale terrorist, wordt hun loyaliteit op de proef gesteld en dreigt hun leven in gevaar te komen.

programme.title: 1918: Journey's End
programme.desc: Vier dagen in maart 1918 in de loopgraven aan het front. Een kleine groep soldaten wacht op een bombardement door vijandelijke artillerie en een zekere dood.

programme.title: Girl in Progress
programme.desc: Als alleenstaande moeder worstelt Grace met werk, rekeningen en haar affaire met een getrouwde dokter. Haar dochter, Ansiedad, probeert snel volwassen te worden met de verhalen over volwassen worden die ze op school leest.

programme.title: Stone
programme.desc: Jack Mabry werkt bij de reclassering en telt de dagen voor zijn pensioen. In de weken die hem resteren wil hij enkele zaken graag afmaken. Eén daarvan is die van brandstichter Gerald “Stone” Creeson...

programme.title: Left Behind
programme.desc: Het is de grootste ramp in de geschiedenis van de mensheid. Het einde der tijden. Miljoenen mensen verdwijnen plotsklaps van de aardbodem; alleen hun kleding en eigendommen blijven achter. Te midden van de ultieme chaos probeert piloot Ray Steele (Nicolas Cage) kalm te blijven.

programme.title: Hallo Bungalow
programme.desc: In een verlopen bungalowpark, lijkt het saaie lot van drie collega’s (Lies Visschedijk, Eva van der Gucht en Anne-Marie Jung) beschoren. Maar dan ontdekken ze dat hun baas (Stefan de Walle) een dubbele agenda heeft, en het park waar zij al zoveel jaren buffelen, slechts een witwaspraktijk is.

programme.title: Brick Mansions
programme.desc: De criminele buitenwijken van Detroit worden overspoeld door geweld en drugs. De gevolgen van misdaad en corrupte raken ieders leven. Bijna dan. Lino (freerunner / parkour master David Belle) levert een dagelijks gevecht om een eerlijk leven te lijden.

programme.title: Hercules in New York
programme.desc: Hercules (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wordt verbannen van Olympus en naar de Aarde gestuurd waar hij ware liefde vindt en een veelbelovende carrière begint als bodybuilder.

programme.title: Arthur & Mike
programme.desc: Wallace Avery haat zijn leven. Zijn baan is doodsaai, zijn ex-vrouw en kinderen ziet hij nauwelijks en zijn nieuwe vriendin irriteert hem. Hij besluit helemaal opnieuw te beginnen.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: Wat heeft een team extreme sporters dat niets anders doet dan big-wave surfing, wingsuit flying, extreme snowboarding, freeclimbing en motorracen te maken met een serie gewelddadige overvallen?

programme.title: The Report
programme.desc: Gebaseerd op ware gebeurtenissen. Een medewerker van de Senaat leidt ’n onderzoek naar ’t detentie- en onderzoeksprogramma van de CIA na 11 september.

programme.title: The Prince
programme.desc: In deze bikkelharde actiethriller keert ex-crimineel Paul na jaren terug naar de onderwereld van New Orleans. Hij heeft een rustig leventje als automonteur aan de andere kant van Amerika.

programme.title: Good Deeds
programme.desc: Als hoofd van het familiebedrijf Deeds Corporation heeft Wesley (Tyler Perry) altijd gedaan wat er van hem verwacht wordt, maar als hij een alleenstaande moeder met problemen ontmoet, gaat hij het leven leiden dat hij altijd gewild heeft.

programme.title: The Trials of Cate McCall
programme.desc: Een voormalig vooraanstaande advocate heeft te kampen met een alcoholverslaving en is erdoor totaal vervreemd geraakt van haar familie. Ze wil zich, na een schorsing voor dit alcoholprobleem, rehabiliteren op haar werk en de voogdij herwinnen over haar dochter.

programme.title: The Hustle
programme.desc: Josephine Chesterfield (Anne Hathaway) is een glamoureuze, verleidelijke Brit met een voorliefde voor het bedriegen van goedgelovige rijke mannen. In haar goed geordende wereld barst Penny Rust (Rebel Wilson), een Australiër die net zo vrij van vorm en plezier is als Josephine berekend en sluw is.

programme.title: Hereditary
programme.desc: Nadat de grootmoeder van de familie Graham overlijdt, werpt de aanwezigheid van deze weinig geliefde vrouw nog steeds een schaduw op het gezin.

programme.title: She's Funny That Way
programme.desc: Het gedoe begint als Broadway-regisseur Arnold de nacht doorbrengt met Izzy (Imogen Poots). De jonge prostituee wil dolgraag actrice worden en Arnold besluit Izzy fors te betalen om haar op weg te helpen. Het gevolg is een en al verwarring, jaloezie, onbegrip en andere kolderieke situaties.

programme.title: Burn
programme.desc: De eenzame en labiele Melinda is werkzaam op een benzinestation waar ze zich voortdurend overschaduwd voelt door haar collega Sheila.

programme.title: Army of One
programme.desc: Gary Faulkner is een ex-gevangene, werkloze klusjesman, Amerikaan en trots op zijn vaderland.

programme.title: American pastoral
programme.desc: Seymour “Swede” Levov, in zijn high-school dagen atleet en nu succesvol zakenman, is getrouwd met voormalige beauty queen Dawn. Zijn leven komt op zijn kop te staan als hun dochter Merry wordt beschuldigd van een terroristische aanslag en vervolgens spoorloos verdwijnt.

programme.title: Take Down
programme.desc: Na een roekeloos auto-ongeluk is de maat vol voor de families van Kyle en Amy. Samen met zes andere verwende en onhandelbare kinderen van gefrustreerde miljardairs worden ze naar een afgelegen eiland net buiten Schotland gestuurd.

programme.title: Weg Van Jou
programme.desc: Romcom die draait om de stadse Evi (Herbers). Met frisse tegenzin wordt ze door haar werkgever van hip Rotterdam overgeplaatst naar stil Zeeuws-Vlaanderen. Dat het niet allemaal onverstaanbare Zeeuwen zijn, blijkt als Evi in Terneuzen de stoere visser Stijn (Heijmans) ontmoet.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Nadat IP Man (Donnie Yen) in de tweede Chinees Japanse oorlog zijn vechtkunsten tegen de Japanners inzette, vluchtte hij in 1949 naar Hongkong en probeerde daar een Wing Chun vechtschool op te richten. Als de machtige meester Hung dat hoort, stelt hij IP Man voor een opgave.

programme.title: Homefront
programme.desc: Voormalig narcotica-agent Phil Broker denkt een rustiger leven te krijgen nu hij zich met zijn dochtertje in een plattelandsstadje heeft gevestigd. Het Amerikaanse zuiden blijkt echter nogal licht ontvlambaar.

programme.title: Project Gemini
programme.desc: Het voortbestaan van de aarde zoals we die kennen wordt bedreigd door een ernstige ecologische crisis. De enige kans op overleving is opzoek gaan naar een tweede thuis… op een andere planeet.

programme.title: Before We Go
programme.desc: New York City. Een jonge vrouw (Alice Eve) haast zich om de trein van 1.30 uur naar Boston te halen. Onderweg wordt ze overvallen en lijkt ze er helemaal alleen voor te staan. Vervolgens ontmoet ze een man (Chris Evans) waarmee ze in de loop van de nacht een onwaarschijnlijke band opbouwt.

programme.title: Automata
programme.desc: De film speelt zich af in de toekomst met de wereld op de rand van een ecologische ineenstorting. De wetenschap staat op het punt om haar droom te realiseren met het creëren van kunstmatige intelligentie.

programme.title: Dirty Grandpa
programme.desc: Over een week gaat de brave advocaat Jason trouwen met Meredith; een ontzettende control freak. Tussen alle trouwdagstress wil zijn opa opeens een lift naar Florida. Maar daar is Spring Break in volle gang en komt het aanstaande huwelijk van Jason plots in gevaar.

programme.title: Dik Trom - De Vetste Film
programme.desc: Dik Trom is een vrolijke, eerlijke, maar vooral gezette jongen. Samen met zijn ouders woont hij in het knusse Dikkedam, waar iedereen net zo dik en uitbundig is als hij. Het is er elke dag feest.

programme.title: Knight of Shadows
programme.desc: Dämonenjäger Pu Songling beschützt die Menschen vor bösen Kreaturen der Unterwelt. Dabei erhält er Unterstützung von einer Horde gutmütiger Dämonen und dem angehenden Polizisten Fei...

programme.title: Shattered Glass
programme.desc: Als de gevierde journalist Stephen Glass onderzocht wordt door een reporter van Forbes wordt duidelijk dat Glass veel van zijn sensationele verhalen verzonnen heeft, wat tot zijn ondergang leidt in dit aangrijpende drama gebaseerd op feiten.

programme.title: Girl in Progress
programme.desc: Als alleenstaande moeder worstelt Grace met werk, rekeningen en haar affaire met een getrouwde dokter. Haar dochter, Ansiedad, probeert snel volwassen te worden met de verhalen over volwassen worden die ze op school leest.

programme.title: Left Behind
programme.desc: Het is de grootste ramp in de geschiedenis van de mensheid. Het einde der tijden. Miljoenen mensen verdwijnen plotsklaps van de aardbodem; alleen hun kleding en eigendommen blijven achter. Te midden van de ultieme chaos probeert piloot Ray Steele (Nicolas Cage) kalm te blijven.

programme.title: Stone
programme.desc: Jack Mabry werkt bij de reclassering en telt de dagen voor zijn pensioen. In de weken die hem resteren wil hij enkele zaken graag afmaken. Eén daarvan is die van brandstichter Gerald “Stone” Creeson...

programme.title: Skin
programme.desc: De beruchte skinhead Byron Widner (Jamie Bell) is door de FBI een van de meest gezochte mannen in Amerika. Hij is van top tot teen getatoeëerd met “White Power” symbolen, die hij verdiend heeft met racistische haatmisdrijven...

programme.title: I am Wrath
programme.desc: Stanley is machteloos als zijn vrouw Vivian bruut door tuig wordt vermoord in een parkeergarage. Haar dood is al niet te verkroppen, maar hij slaat pas echt door als de corrupte politie de daders laat lopen.

programme.title: Paseka: The Easter Elephant
programme.desc: On Easter morning, a baby elephant is mysteriously abandoned by her herd in the wilds of Botswana's Okavango Delta. Saved from certain death by a bizarre chain of events, she forces herself into a very unusual, captive elephant herd. This is "Paseka's" story. We follow her first year in this spectacular African wilderness, learning daily what it means to be an elephant. What is instinctive? What is she taught by the elephants? What does she need to learn from the humans? How does her arrival change the herd dynamics? Her unique journey is our window into the elephant world.

programme.desc: With summer wildfires overpowering the Yukon forests, host/adventurer George Kourounis follows the fabled route of the Klondike Gold Rush sourdoughs through the bawdy town of Skagway, Alaska, paddling the white water rivers and the White Horse Rapids into the Yukon. He travels on mountain bike, steam train and Cessna to experience the huge fires and meet the northern fire crews battling the blazes.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Angry Planet | Wild Weather of 2005
programme.desc: George tracks twisters through the Tornado Alley and descends into the Erte Ale Volcano.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Angry Planet | Wild Water
programme.desc: George investigates the wild side of water in dangerous class 5 river rapids.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Mount Washington, New Hampshire has the dubious title of being home to the world’s worst weather. The highest wind ever recorded on the planet – 231 miles per hour – was recorded at its mountaintop observatory. To prepare for a mid-winter assault on the summit, Angry Planet host George Kourounis becomes a “human popsicle”, encased in ice in at the National Resarch Council’s high speed wind tunnel. Then he and his sidekick Mark Robinson climb to the top of the mountain in mid-January and brave their way into a summit blizzard.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Angry Planet | Boiling Lake
programme.desc: Dominica, the most volcanic and mountainous island in the Caribbean, is home to the Boiling Lake, a large waterfall-fed lake of furiously boiling water. Adventurer George Kourounis becomes the first person ever to traverse across the lake on a rope, risking his life to take water samples and shoot video from a place no human has ever been. He then dives to the ocean floor off the coast of the island to explore vents where the superheated water bubbles into the ocean.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 Angry Planet | Hottest & Coldest
programme.desc: George experiences the most extreme climates in North America. First he visits the hottest place on the continent – Death Valley, then the coldest – Snag, Yukon.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: S02 : E04 Angry Planet | B.C. Caving
programme.desc: In the porous limestone of Canada’s West Coast, great forces are at work under the ground, building and eroding the underground into fantastic shapes. In this episode we’ll witness George’s explorations of these massive underground cave systems.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: S02 : E06 Angry Planet | Thunder Down Under
programme.desc: Stormchasing developed in Australia in the same period – the 1990s – as it developed in the American Midwest. In the first week of December – the height of storm season in Australia, we plan to travel with Jimmy Deguara, the most experienced of Australian stormchasers.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: S02 : E08 Angry Planet | Italia Wild
programme.desc: Italy is one of the very few nations in the world that regularly gets three major extreme natural phenomena – volcanos, flooding, and avalanches. Eastern flanks of the volcano to slip by up to two metres, and many houses on the flanks of the volcano experienced structural damage. The eruption also completely destroyed the Rifugio Sapienza, on the southern flank of the volcano. The Rifugio was the site of a cable car station which had previously been destroyed in the 1983 eruption; both have now been rebuilt. The most recent eruption was in November 2006.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: S02 : E10 Angry Planet | By Camel to Timbuktu
programme.desc: It is time for “Angry Planet” to do a serious desert episode. What better place to do it than this fabled city in the middle of the mighty Sahara Desert.This almost mythical place really does exist. And it really is still possible to travel there by camel caravan, riding the infamous “Ships of the Desert”. Extreme heat, dehydration, possible sand storms, frigid night temperatures and desert predators are our potential companions for the trip.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: S02 : E12 Angry Planet | Java - Land of Fire
programme.desc: Geoorge explores Java at the heart of the Ring of Fire.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: S03 : E01 Angry Planet | Hurricane Triple Threat
programme.desc: “Angry Planet” is there as 3 storms make landfall as hurricanes in the US.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: No-one creates eco-disasters on quite the scale of the former Soviet Union. In Uzbekistan, the Aral Sea, once one of the largest freshwater lakes in the world, has seen its waters diverted, so that it has shrunk to 1/6 its previous size. In Crimea, a mountain has been carved into a james bondian submarine base. In northern Ukraine, the Chernobyl nuclear site has been reduced to a radioactive wasteland.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George returns to the “Fin Del Mundo” at the southern tip of Argentina, this time to sail on a Russian icebreaker to Antarctica. After braving the stormy Drake passage, he explores volcanic Deception Island, camps out in the Antarctic snow, and paddles a kayak through icebergs calved off the melting glaciers.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: S03 : E07 Angry Planet | Polynesian Volcanoes
programme.desc: Filming the volcanoes, mudpools and geysers in the geothermic wonderland of New Zealand’s north island, we learn that a new island is being created by an undersea volcano 1000 miles north in Tonga. Determined to be among the first to see this “newest land on earth”, we head for the remote island by plane and boat, after various nautical mishaps, George ends up, bedraggled and clad in nothing but underwear and a lifejacket, honored to be one of the very first to explore this brand new island.

programme.title: Extreme Weather Countdown
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Extreme Weather Countdown | Throwing Porta Potties to the Wind
programme.desc: The world is a dangerous place, and with wild weather occurances happening every 20 seconds, it's no wonder we never have a shortage of footage to showcase here. The videos we have gathered are guarenteed to blow you away, so let's not waste anymore time and jump right into it.

programme.title: Extreme Weather Countdown
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 Extreme Weather Countdown | Oh Hail No
programme.desc: What's windy, wild, and wet all over? The weather, of course! And over the next half hour, we're bringing you some of the craziest moments ever captured on camera! From the hailstorms that destory windows to the breathtaking tornados, we've got it all, right here on Extreme Weather Countdown.

programme.title: Extreme Weather Countdown
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 Extreme Weather Countdown | The Final Countdown
programme.desc: When bad weather strikes, most people head in doors, but we head right into the heart of it. And now you can too, experiencing every thunderbolt, every dust storm, and every flood, all from the comfort of your own home. Let's jump right in!

programme.title: Extreme Weather Countdown
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 Extreme Weather Countdown | Earth, Wind, and Wildfire
programme.desc: We always take weather for granted, but when Mother Nature turns up the heat, she forces us to pay attention.

programme.desc: Firefighters perform a ride inspection at a travelling carnival; firefighters extinguish a blazing ATV.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E41 Mind Game: Mai Vs. Marik, Part 1
programme.desc: The third duel of the Battle City Finals between Mai and Marik is no ordinary duel; it’s a battle in the dreaded Shadow Realm where losing life points equals losing your memories! As Marik’s true sinister self comes to the surface, does Mai stand a chance against this malevolent evil?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E42 Mind Game: Mai Vs. Marik, Part 2
programme.desc: As Mai loses more and more of her memories under Marik’s relentless assault, she loses confidence in her dueling abilities. Will Yugi and friends’ neverending support bring her back to victory, or will her shattered mind be trapped in the Shadow Realm for eternity?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E43 Mind Game: Mai Vs. Marik, Part 3
programme.desc: Mai gains control of Marik’s The Winged Dragon of Ra, but she’s unable to decipher how to unleash its massively powerful abilities! Can Mai solve the mystery of the Egyptian God Card before Marik solves it himself and incinerates Mai with the full fury of The Winged Dragon of Ra?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E44 A Duel With Destiny: Kaiba Vs. Ishizu, Part 1
programme.desc: In the fourth duel of the Battle City Finals, Kaiba’s mystery opponent is… Ishizu! With the power of her Millennium Necklace, Ishizu can see the future, including every card Kaiba is planning to play! Does Kaiba stand a chance against an opponent who knows his moves even before he does?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E45 A Duel With Destiny: Kaiba Vs. Ishizu, Part 2
programme.desc: Ishizu, using the magic of her Millennium Necklace, has already seen the outcome of the duel – she will defeat Kaiba with her trap! How can Kaiba win when it’s already destined that he will lose? It’s time for Kaiba to change the future!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: As Marik’s evil grows, Ishizu reveals the secrets of her bloodline: How did Marik transform from a kind child into a power-hungry tyrant out for world domination? Can Yugi save Marik from the edge of darkness, or is he already beyond salvation?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E47 Showdown in the Shadows: Marik Vs. Bakura, Part 1
programme.desc: With their previous pact broken, Bakura duels Marik for the right to control the Millennium Rod and the Millennium Ring, and the loser will be trapped inside the Shadow Realm forever! To tip the odds, Bakura gains an unexpected ally in the form of… another Marik?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E48 Showdown in the Shadows: Marik Vs. Bakura, Part 2
programme.desc: Bakura and good Marik summon The Winged Dragon of Ra, ready to blast and banish evil Marik into the Shadow Realm! But The Winged Dragon of Ra has more than one special ability, and evil Marik knows how to use them all!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: As Kaiba’s blimp speeds towards KaibaCorp Island for the final rounds of the Battle City Tournament, the ship is hijacked by a mysterious boy named Noah and his henchmen – five familiar foes from Yugi and Kaiba’s past who are out for revenge! With the power of cyberspace on Noah’s side, Yugi and friends are trapped inside a new and dangerous Duel Monsters game!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E02 Isolated in Cyber Space — Part 1"
programme.desc: Noah displays the power of his virtual world by splitting up Yugi’s gang and flinging them into the far reaches of his self-created universe! The first to duel under the all-new Deck Master System is Yugi against Big 1 Gansley’s Deepsea Warrior! Can Yugi master the complex new rules, or will the rules master him?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E03 Isolated in Cyber Space — Part 2
programme.desc: Yugi faces off against Gansley, in the form of "Deepsea Warrior", but struggles with the complexities of the dueling field and the new rules. Tea faces peril from a vicious tribe of cyclopses while Kaiba and Mokuba are brought to a setting similar to their old orphanage.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E04 Isolated in Cyber Space — Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi's strategy is hindered by Gansley's Deck Master ability. Tristan and Duke face a mean dinosaur to save Serenity. Meanwhile, Kaiba and Mokuba confront painful visions of their miserable childhood, but within the heartache may lurk the key to Noah's true intentions.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Téa is led by a penguin to Crump, in the form of Nightmare Penguin, who challenges her to a duel. She learns immediately that dueling in the virtual realm differs starkly from her previous duels, and starts to succumb to the virtual playing field.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Despite gaining a lead with Maha Vailo, Téa falls behind as Crump begins an assault on her life points, causing the ice around her to grow. With the help of her Deck Master, Dark Magician Girl, and Yugi's Dark Magician, Téa gains enough confidence to win.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey faces the Big 5's lawyer, Johnson, in a courtroom duel. Joey pulls an early lead with his Deck Master, Flame Swordsman, but Johnson's Deck Master, Judge Man, has abilities of his own.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey attempts to pull through with several luck-based cards, but Johnson's cheating tactics ruin all his chances, until an angry Noah puts a stop to him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Tristan, Duke and Serenity duel Nesbitt, the Big 5's mechanical expert. Serenity's lack of experience with the game and Nesbit's powerful machine monsters create a tragic end for Tristan.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: With Tristan gone and Serenity in shock, Duke attempts to defeat Nesbitt by himself. But when Orgoth the Relentless is destroyed by his Perfect Machine King, Duke tries to help Serenity regain confidence in her abilities. The two later remember Tristan's face down card, hoping it will help them win.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E11 Settling the Score — Part 1
programme.desc: As Nesbitt (in Tristan's body) kidnaps Mokuba, Kaiba is forced to duel Lector, the former assistant to his stepfather. For Lector, the duel is personal, as he plans to take what he believes is rightfully his—KaibaCorp. Meanwhile, Tristan rejoins the group; his friends do not recognize him, since his mind has been downloaded into a mechanical monkey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E12 Settling the Score — Part 2
programme.desc: With Lector's Jinzo Deck Master destroying all of Kaiba's traps, Imperial Order destroying all his spell cards, and Lector's unreachable Satellite Cannon striking from space, Kaiba doesn't seem to stand a chance. Mokuba's unwavering faith in Kaiba keeps him believing that his brother will pull out with a victory, but Noah has plans to ruin their brotherhood.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi, Kaiba, and Tea are separated from the others as the Big 5 (minus Nesbitt) plan to take their bodies anyway. As Noah tortures Kaiba by brainwashing Mokuba, he reveals his true identity as Gozaboro Kaiba's biological son.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E14 Merger of the Big Five — Part 1

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E15 Merger of the Big Five — Part 2
programme.desc: The Big 5 attempt various strategies of victory, with the aim of eliminating Joey first. However, their poor teamwork soon puts Yugi and Joey ahead. Lector then calls their most powerful monster to the field, the Five Head Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E16 Merger of the Big Five — Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi and Joey are forced to use their strongest monsters to take down the Five-Headed Dragon.

programme.sub-title: S03 : E17 Brothers in Arms — Part 1
programme.desc: Kaiba and Noah duel for full control of KaibaCorp, but Noah's revelations and constant manipulation of the playing field complicate things for Kaiba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E18 Brothers in Arms — Part 2
programme.desc: Noah's Shinato's Ark puts Kaiba in a difficult position, as he scrambles to find a winning strategy.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.sub-title: S03 : E20 Noah's Final Threat — Part 1

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E24 Burying the Past — Part 2
programme.desc: ami Marik destroys the computers in the control room, disabling the controls for the self-destruct mechanism, which turns the situation desperate. Meanwhile, Kaiba defeats Gozoboro Kaiba, and he and Yugi rush to the exit before the virtual world explodes. Noah erases Gozoboro's files and releases his mind, and finally makes peace with his family, and prepares for the destruction of the virtual world.

At that time, Kite, using Dr. Faker's technology, retraces Astral's memories and invites Yuma to the World Duel Carnival.

But what will Yuma do when he has no Heart Pieces, which serve as the proof of participation for the WDC? Meanwhile, Mr. Heartland and Kite make their preparations to gather the Numbers that are likely to assemble before them in this tournament.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma's first opponent in the World Duel Carnival is the soccer kid, Striker. Striker transforms the surrounding stadium with his Field Spell Card, as the Duel kicks off. With his "Offside Trap", Striker brilliantly seals Yuma's strategies, while his teammate monsters use teamwork to frantically keep beating Yuma up with a combo of offense and defense and with such sheer strength, it seems as if Striker's victory is decided...

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Allie is looking to make a big splash at the Arc League Championship, but she soon finds herself in over her head! Can Allie's deck of fishy friends turn the tides, or will her mysterious opponent sink her chances of winning?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

Yami Marik quickly discards his Winged Dragon of Ra to the graveyard, planning to revive it. Yugi manages to summon Slifer the Sky Dragon using his three Knights.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E42 The Final Face Off — Part 2

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

As he fades away, Marik appears to an unconscious Odion, thanks him for taking care of him and apologizes, wishing that he could take back his cruel actions. In a cliffhanger, Odion is revealed to have been awakened by Marik's apology.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

Finally, he summons Dark Magician and Dark Magician Girl and uses them to activate Ragnarok – a spell card with the ability to destroy all the monsters on Marik's field, including The Winged Dragon of Ra that he fused himself with. (The card actually negates and removes all cards Marik controls, at the cost of banishing all monsters to the graveyard that Yami Yugi has.) But Yami Marik claims that if Ra is destroyed (which will leave the good Marik with only 1 life point), then the good Marik will be too weak to resist the power of the Shadow Realm, and will consequently lose his soul....

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S04 : E01 A New Evil, Part 1

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S04 : E53 Jodha Akbar S4 E53
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E26 A King and His Queen S2 E26
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S04 : E65 Jodha Akbar S4 E65
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.
